comparison.objective: Deploy a folding ramp between floor and step, versus tune and lock a robot-axis damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Large articulated-panel unfolding and placement versus small-tool alignment, fine collar rotation, counterholding, and force-limited locking.
comparison.success_condition: Ramp geometry and stability versus two non-bottoming physical impact cycles with setting retention.
comparison.reason: The tested abilities and end states are meaningfully different. Body and specs are absent, so ramp tolerances and failure thresholds are missing.
